findings.text: This file is outside the node's granted write paths, yet the node's declared gate runs it: adding a required fifth scope noul to the shared question set leaves this test's hand-built answer set one noul short, so the re-judge drops every file and the gate cannot pass without the edit. The node made the minimal keyword-defaulted change the sibling test carries, declared it in commit 6c3109ac1, the fragment's scope note and the manifest's follow_ons, and check-manifest reports it as the run's only finding. The two grants are in tension and the coordinator must adjudicate: accept the widening, or drop tests/discovery/test_code_ingested_rejudge.py from the gate the spec names.

The new question separates the reconstruction-database reader from the solver at the noul level (31/31 EQDB above gate at 0.67-0.96, 20/20 solvers below at 0.19-0.34), but not at the composite level: the 20 solver files keep a composite of 0.42-0.56 because the other four scope nouls already fire for a solver that reads the equilibrium and maps it to IMAS, so a names-arm triage gate reading score_composite still admits them. The node states this explicitly in the fragment and records it as a follow-on rather than leaving it silent, and the spec did not ask it to lower the composite for solvers, but a downstream reader who relies on the composite gate will not see the new separation without a further rule.

justifications.durability: The change is guarded and the guard fires. tests/discovery/test_code_relevance.py:test_scope_question_set_has_five_nouls_in_both_arms renders the template in both arms and asserts every SCOPE_NOULS name is present, so removing the question from triage.md fails; test_composite_is_the_largest_of_five_nouls pins the composite as the largest of five (0.85 from a 0.85 reconstruction answer over four low ones), and the negative control shows exactly this test exits 1 when the noul is removed from SCOPE_NOULS, a failure that does not exist at head; test_names_arm_writes_the_reconstruction_db_field asserts the field and the composite on a triaged file; tests/discovery/test_reset.py pins the name target's discovered/skipped pair, its rendered AND-narrowed query, its cleared fields and the absence of source_filter and post_cypher. 18 rather than 20 because the negative control exercises only the composite test, so the reset target and the both-arms rendering rest on their own assertions rather than a demonstrated failing-then-fixed arm, and nothing pins the live-check separation itself, which is a live measurement rather than a graded assertion. No regression in the graded behaviour is left unpinned in the graded suite.
justifications.evidence: The evidence is an independent instrument and it reconciles. The live check is raw and reproduces the fragment exactly: live_check.json carries 31 eqdb rows and 20 sims rows, threshold 0.40, scope_nouls listed, the eqdb new-noul range 0.67-0.96 with 31/31 above gate, the pre-change four-noul composite above gate for exactly 18/31 (live_check_four.log), and the sims new-noul range 0.19-0.34 all below gate. explain.json records all three changed statements EXPLAIN ok with the rendered Cypher, and build_models.log plus imas_codex/graph/models.py:17022 confirm the generated model carries relevance_reconstruction_db. 19 rather than 20 because the quoted live ranges are one stochastic sample: the fifth question is an LLM judgement and the two saved runs disagree on it for the same files (sims 0.19-0.34 in live_check.json vs 0.17-0.32 in live_check_four.log), so the numbers are a single draw and the selection provenance of the 20 solver files is not instrumented in the saved artifacts.
justifications.fit: The change reads as the surrounding code. The new noul is a plain entry in the shared question block, the field is registered through the existing CODE_RELEVANCE_FIELDS/_RELEVANCE_FIELDS single-owner registry, the reset target uses the module's extra_filter AND-narrowing idiom with a comment that states the mechanism (why source_filter would OR-widen and why a skipped file needs no cascade) and the sibling content target's shape, and the docstrings and facility.yaml descriptions are updated from four to five scope questions in step.
